abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the ability of several radioimmunoassays and commercial two-site immunoassays to detect the first World Health Organization International Reference Reagents (IRRs) for 6 defined human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) variants and to compare their performance in measuring hCG in sera from patients with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) and germ cell tumors (GCTs) of the testis or ovary. STUDY DESIGN: The reactivity of the different assays with the 6 IRRs together with the current fourth International Standard (IS, 75/589) was tested using 5 commercial two-site assays as well as 2 competitive polyclonal radioimmunoassays (RIAs) and a competitive monoclonal immunoassay. Individual samples from 41 patients (19 GCT and 22 GTD) with high circulating levels of hCG (range, 718-6,055,000 IU/L) were diluted and measured using the various immunoassays. RESULTS: The results of 4 GCT patient samples varied markedly among the assays, including 1 sample that was grossly underestimated by 3 of the commercial assays. CONCLUSION: Comparison of each assay's reactivity to the variant isoforms revealed that recognition of the isoforms was highly variable, particularly for hCGbeta and hCGbeta core fragment (hCGbetacf).
abstract_ja: 目的：6種類のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)変異体について、最初の世界保健機関(WHO)国際参照試薬(IRR)を検出する複数の放射免疫測定法および市販の二点免疫測定法の能力を測定し、精巣または卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)および妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の患者血清におけるhCG測定性能を比較すること。研究デザイン：第4次国際標準(IS, 75/589)とともに、6種のIRRに対する各アッセイの反応性を、5種の市販二点免疫測定法、2種の競合的ポリクローナル放射免疫測定法、競合的モノクローナル免疫測定法を用いて検討した。hCG濃度が高い(718～6,055,000 IU/L)GCT 19例とGTD 22例、計41例の患者の個々の検体を希釈し、各種免疫測定法で測定した。結果：GCT患者の検体4例の結果はアッセイ間で大きく異なり、そのうち1例は市販アッセイ3種で著しく過小評価された。結論：変異体アイソフォームに対する各アッセイの反応性を比較した結果、アイソフォームの認識能は極めて多様であり、特にhCGβおよびhCGβコア断片(hCGβcf)で顕著であった。
